Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.action

package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.action
What an NPC does when a player interacts with it.

An ActionDefinition is the stored "type: argument" pair, a NpcActionHandler is the code that runs it, and ActionRegistry maps one to the other. Registering a handler makes a new action type available in every NPC's configuration.
